items.Title: Human Resources Director – Israel
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Verint Israel site in Herzliya is one of the most significant Verint’s R&D centers worldwide. We are part of a successful global organization but enjoy being a dynamic local site of 200 passionate and creative experts. Our teams move fast in a flexible hybrid model, and utilize cutting-edge technology such as AI & AI-Powered Bots, Machine Learning, NLP, and Speech & Text Analytics to elevate customer experience and improve customers’ lives globally.

items.ExternalResponsibilitiesStr:
Job Description

  • Serve as the senior HR advisor for the Israel site, partnering with local and global leaders to translate business strategy into effective people plans.
  • Operate as the primary HR leader for the location, aligning site priorities with Verint’s global people philosophy while ensuring local relevance and execution.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on organization design, workforce planning, performance management, retention, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Coach managers on effective leadership, feedback, and performance differentiation within a high‑performance R&D environment.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and global HR COEs to support hiring
items.ExternalQualificationsStr:
Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including senior HRBP or HR Director responsibility for a country or regional population.
  • Deep, hands‑on expertise in Israel employment law, HR practices, and local market norms (required).
  • Proven experience supporting R&D or technology organizations in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment.
  • Sound judgment and comfort managing complexity and ambiguity.
  • Background in a global SaaS, technology, or product‑led organization.
  • Fluent Hebrew and English required
